reviews.text: This is such a fun game! I've never played a game like this, so I didn't know what to expect. I ended up really enjoying it! I think Hive Jump 2: Survivors is a fantastic introduction to survival roguelikes, and I could see myself trying out more games in the genre because of this. Once you start playing you won't want to stop!

I live my gaming life under the dollar an hour rule. You spend $1 you should get 1 hour of enjoyment out of it, this game smashes that goal like nothing. For 5 dollars or even 7 dollars it is well worth the price tag. Having been a fan of vampire survivor, death must die and 20 minutes to dawn this game fits right at home. It's only in beta so there's nowhere to go but up!

A Vampire Survivors (VS) clone with aliens as enemies. [h1] Pros: [/h1] - Art is on par with games with other games in the genre. - Developers are responsive to your questions if you ask on their Discord. - Menus are easy to read. - Multiple difficulties to try. 0 is the first one and you unlock more by beating each difficulty. - Achievement menu shows what you unlocked and still need to get. - Has controller support. [h2] Neutral/Suggestions: [/h2] - Only 2 maps right now, but more content is being added later. - For objectives, the yellow arrow needs to be bigger and easier to see. - Locking new characters behind specific achievements is not preferred. Add other ways to unlock them. - Some of the flashing lights emitted from weapons makes it hard to see incoming enemies and if they survived. Maybe, make the enemies stand out more or reduce the weapon lighting. [h3] Cons: [/h3] - No tutorial level, only tips menu. - The skills are not as intuitive as some other games in the genre. It's not clear what some of the upgrades do such utility, grenade, and gun. This would be improved if they had more details about what a skill/upgrade does. - The outside currency/shop for getting upgrades is extremely grindy. Amber currency takes multiple runs to accumulate and are farmed by killing eggs. Conclusion: Overall, a promising Survivors game that could use some polish. Looking forward to playing the game when more content is released.

The movement in this game is absolutely phenomenal. Every game I love to experiment with a different build (despite gambling my hard earned goo away for rerolls LOL). Definitely a very fun game to explore with missions and hives to destroy, there really is no complaints I have. 100% should give it a shot.

If you like top down vampire survivor esque games, this is definitely something to check out. Lots of neat weapons, you can get so powerful you break the game, decent amount of challenge in the difficulties until you figure out builds, and more fun to unlock different survivors by maxing out weapons. Easily worth $7, give it a shot. EDIT: There is no f*cking way someone recommended Swarm Grinder over this. That dude has brain damage.

A fun and unique twist on the survivors genre! The game will absolutely kick your teeth in the first handful of runs, so just focus on getting stuff like scattershot and grenades that can hit loads of targets at once, then try and grab amber from eggs around the map so you can start getting some of the meta progression down. After the rough start, this game gets much more interesting. There's hand crafted maps with secrets on the first one, unlocks that require trying different builds, and a number of weapons to try out. If you're looking for a survivors style game with its own unique niche in the genre, this is a good place to look!

A great little Survivor-like with some of the worst end game i have ever seen in a Survivor-like. I enjoy the game, i really do, but when i get one shot, out ran, and telefragged, in 3 separate runs on anything higher than the 4th difficulty, i get more annoyed than anything else. And its not like i don't try to counter the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. The tankiest jumper still gets 2 shot MAX, the fastest jumper STILL gets outran, and the most OP jumper still gets rekt from standing too close to a hive and telefragged by a spawning enemy. And yes. I have maxed out the skill tree. I got my money's worth, im not going to rate the game down since it was and is still a fun game. But the endgame needs some serious work.

Survival game that mostly use guns, aiming is not on Dev priority to improve. Manual aim only for 1st slot only. If you start with non gun item, no more aiming until you sell the 1st slot item to move up the gun item. There's no inventory organizing to help with this problem either. This have been in the game since demo and post 1.0 release.

This game has a fun core gameplay loop that is ruined by weird game design decisions. You are a hive jumper tasked with surviving multiple waves of alien bugs on a large stage. You get weapon choices at the end of each wave that require a currency you earn from killing bugs. That part is fun. What I don't like: The currency for permanent upgrades is SLOW to gain, and basically requires you to hunt it down on the stage instead of killing bugs. Most upgrades for me right now cost 150-200 but I'm lucky if I get 50 currency per run, it just feels terrible that I have to prioritize not winning a stage because I need to get amber and don't have time to kill the enemies on screen. There is only one grenade ability, yet there are 2-3 (not 100% sure) passive upgrades for grenades. They offer you grenade upgrades when you don't even have a grenade ability diluting the pool of decent choices of which there are really not that many anyway. There is also 2 (maybe 3?) "utility" weapons you can get. You have to use a bit of brain power to realize that these are the only weapon slot choices affected by the passive upgrades that affect utility items, which of course are offered to you even when you have NO utility item chosen. The passive upgrades are quiet possibly some of the most boring I have ever seen. When you kill an enemy you get 1 goo, some of the upgrades are for example gain 20% more goo, while using your jetpack (which only lasts like 1 second-1.5 second). Wow 20% more on 1x item? Its just really boring. During every stage there are random challenges that appear, in the early waves you get less than a minute you need to survive making finding and completing some of these challenges impossible. They do not show up on any large map you can open and you must already be fairly close to them to even see where you need to go.

I hate to give this a negative because it could be much better with some tweaks. These games have to be super tight to compete in this genre. First there are simple bugs: -You can jetpack while moving diagonally up, but not diagonally down. -Some guns float just north of you (not like above you in the Z axis) and therefore cannot fire if you have a wall north of you. Then there are design frustrations: -Bugs can shoot and fly over walls, but I can't even shoot over halfwalls, so if I'm being followed while "vaulting" I won't even target them. -Upgrades are handled weirdly - I can spend half a run failing to play a matching game for a certain weapon, but then randomly just find something way better by dumb luck. Or switch from poison to a cryo weapon seconds before the boss only to find that cryo doesn't work on bosses (Why?) -Leveling feels underwhelming - "Wow 5% faster grenade rate when I'm jumping..." C'mon. Then bad art choices: -The UI popups are simultaneously way too big and constantly getting in the way, but also silent so I won't even know a mission has popped up because I have to ignore a bunch floating text about a useless upgrade I got last wave. -Everything is glowing. The enemies, the ground drops, my projectiles, the enemy's projectiles, the UI, inert decorations in the background, water hazards, little computers on the wall that may or may not even come into play at all, etc etc. When really only things that are dangerous or beneficial should really glow. Tweak this and it could be great and get a thumbs up.

There are much better survivorlikes out there. The upgrade options during runs are limited and dreadfully boring. Can't speak much for the meta progression. Takes a lot of grinding for minuscule upgrades. Not compelling enough to stick with it.

a good game (not a great game) with a really cool aesthetic and the unusual yet refreshing inclusion of a "jetpack" game mechanic. its definitely not grabbing the way i wanted it too but i'll give it another hour or two to gets it hooks into me and then update this review. as it stands, its worth its asking price. the biggest drawback of the game is that the primary currency (utilized for permanent upgrades) is hard/slow to come by thus rendering the game more about the grind for hunting currency rather than the (more acceptable and expected) grind of exterminating bugs. update: attempted a few more runs - the game just isn't fun or rewarding enough to keep me engaged. i just can't justify the money/time for it. perhaps if i was significantly more skilled and there werent similar options that were more fulfilling for me as a gamer, i'd be willing to devote more time. however, with steam's refund policies the way they are - one only has 2 hours or less to make the choice whether or not to keep a game...and this is a no go for me. its disappointing in that all of the ingredients for a great game are here - they just weren't implemented correctly. 6\10. its not a bad game but its certainly not for me and not what i thought it would be.

NOPE. Getting a refund since it's not even worth the tree-fiddy if I won't ever play it again. I'm generally not a fan of survivor-likes, but e.g. Halls of Torment is fun. This game is not. • Where is the epic Doom music from the trailer?!? The game just has an electronic soundtrack that's baiscally 1 repeating melody which gets annoying after 10 minutes. • slooow movement • slooow meta progression • no really interesting upgrades and pick-ups • Hives and elite enemies are ultra bullet sponges – during my first run, it felt like I was kiting the Crusher for an hour to finish the run without getting any meaningful upgrades while doing so.

翻译不统一，导致一些东西我都不知道是干嘛的。 狙击手走路慢就慢吧，但比初始小怪还慢，被一群小怪拱着走是不是有点不对了？ 游戏里有两种升级，一种是直接加属性，一种是使用喷气背包期间加属性，但问题是同品质加的属性一样多，我就想问了，那后者有何存在的意义？相同品质的两者我拿哪个？为什么后者多了一个限制条件却没有任何提升？你会做游戏吗？ 没有枪械伤害升级，却遍地都是榴弹伤害升级，我不想玩榴弹就想玩枪的话，恶不恶心？ 解锁的新局内升级一堆狗屎，完完全全的污染卡池。 作为一个主打道具合成的游戏，居然只有三个装备栏能用，连个背包仓库都没有。 暂停看不到装备属性。
